result.reason: The clause includes the preferred CGL, E&O, and conditional cyber limits and requires certificates on request, but omits workers’ compensation coverage as required by law. The requirement to maintain all coverages for one year after the term is not required by the playbook and adds an unnecessary obligation. The existing representation-by-counsel provision is otherwise preserved, and the operative language is generally professionally drafted; the margin comment does not cure the workers’ compensation omission.
